name: Accessibility and safety
summary: Score a card for flashing, contrast, reading time and motion, check caption files, and build calm motion modes into a card.
qualityBar: Colour maths matches the WCAG references; palette helper marks dim #475569 as never for words
Planted faults are caught: 7.5 and 4 flashes a second, a red flash of equal brightness, 2.6:1 text, whole-picture shake, full-screen moving pattern, a rushed six-word line, bad caption cues
Safe neighbours pass: exactly 3 flashes a second, a 1 Hz pulse with a note, a calm readable card scores 95 or more with no issues
The demo passes in full, reduced and none motion modes and scores at least the 96 its dial shows
The ported tt10 and its real caption file pass with a score of 85 and honest notes
verifiedBy: 2026-11-19: node test.mjs exit 0 at full size (41 checks passed, 0 failed, about 1.3 min). Colour maths, flash counting, caption rules and the motion kit unit-checked; nine planted-fault cards behaved as designed (7.5 and 4 flashes a second fail, exactly 3 passes, equal-brightness red/green strobe caught as a red flash only, #475569 text fails at 2.58:1, shake and full-screen moving pattern caught, rushed six-word line flagged, calm card 96+); the demo passes in full, reduced and none modes with a real score of 96 (the 96 on its dial); engine hello_card scores 100; ported tt10 scores 85 with its real caption file (real findings: 3 caption lines over 42 characters, 2 quick button labels). Demo rendered 1080x1920, 8.0 s, silent, checker passed. I viewed out/contact.png and judged it good. NOT checked: this is a heuristic tripwire, not the Harding test or a medical clearance; the flash block size (a ninth of the frame) and all thresholds are my reading of WCAG, not validated against a certified analyser; zoom, spin and per-layer parallax are not measured; the shake detector was only tested on a synthetic card and a whole-frame pattern, not on a real shaking card; no real viewer with photosensitivity or colour-blindness looked at anything; motion judged from stills.
